lines.zh: 冷水顺着我的侧线流过，彩虹一闪。
lines.en: Cold water runs along my flank, and my rainbow stripe flares.

lines.zh: 我贴着河流的浅底，一路向上游。
lines.en: I hug the shallow riverbed and push upstream.

lines.zh: 河水越冷，我的条纹越亮。
lines.en: The colder the river, the brighter my stripe burns.

lines.zh: 四条同伴排成一列，逆流摆尾。
lines.en: Four of us line up, tails beating against the current.

lines.zh: 沙粒在腹下翻滚，我顺着它走。
lines.en: Sand rolls beneath my belly and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我从沙滩的浪口滑回深水。
lines.en: I slide from the beach break back into deeper water.

lines.zh: 每一摆尾，彩虹就掠过水草。
lines.en: Each tailbeat sends my rainbow flickering past the weeds.

lines.zh: 寒冷的海沟正合我的鳞片。
lines.en: This cold trench suits my scales perfectly.

lines.zh: 我绕开礁石，沿着岩缝巡游。
lines.en: I round the reef and cruise along the rock seams.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我便借力前游。
lines.en: The current shoves me, so I borrow its push.

lines.zh: 条纹在水下暗了又亮，像警报。
lines.en: My stripe dims and flares underwater, like a warning.

lines.zh: 我游到潮边，那里虫子最多。
lines.en: I drift to the tide line where the insects crowd.

lines.zh: 产卵的浅滩还远，我慢慢赶。
lines.en: The spawning shallows are far; I take my time.

lines.zh: 冷水拖着我的影子，一同向前。
lines.en: Cold water drags my shadow forward with me.

lines.zh: 我钻进桥墩的影子里歇一会儿。
lines.en: I slip into the bridge pier's shade to rest.

lines.zh: 水位降了，我沿着卵石往下溜。
lines.en: The water dropped, so I slide down the cobbles.

lines.zh: 三条同伴在前，我落后半尾。
lines.en: Three companions ahead; I trail half a tail.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上收线，我转身就走。
lines.en: Someone reels in on the bank. I turn away.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草间，让鳃慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds and let my gills work slowly.

lines.zh: 一串气泡升上去，我没有动。
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises; I do not move.

lines.zh: 寒冷让我清醒，也让我懒。
lines.en: The cold keeps me awake and lazy at once.

lines.zh: 我数着水面的光斑，一动不动。
lines.en: I count the light spots on the surface, unmoving.

lines.zh: 鳞片上的彩虹沉下去，歇一歇。
lines.en: My rainbow settles down for a moment's rest.

lines.zh: 河底的石头有话，我听着。
lines.en: The river stones have something to say, and I listen.

lines.zh: 我轻轻吐气，把沙吹成小坑。
lines.en: I breathe out softly and blow a small pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 同伴绕着我转，我懒得理。
lines.en: My companions circle me; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 三条鱼挤在岩影里，一起发呆。
lines.en: Three of us crowd a rock's shadow and drift blankly.

lines.zh: 我咬住一片水草，又放开。
lines.en: I nip a strand of weed, then let it go.

lines.zh: 水太清，连我的影子都看得见。
lines.en: The water is so clear I can see my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我停在入海口，尝咸淡交界。
lines.en: I rest at the river mouth, tasting where salt meets fresh.

lines.zh: 远处有网影，我先不动声色。
lines.en: A net shadow passes far off; I stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 寒冷的海水把我养得很慢。
lines.en: Cold seawater raises me slowly, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我先看你的手。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, so I watch your hands first.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的条纹亮了一格。
lines.en: You stand too close, and my stripe lights one notch.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰间的鱼竿，不是脸。
lines.en: I am watching the rod at your belt, not your face.

lines.zh: 你踩响了卵石，我抬头对着你。
lines.en: A pebble clicks underfoot and I turn to face you.

lines.zh: 眼睛对眼睛，我先眨眼。
lines.en: Eye to eye, I blink first.

lines.zh: 你若撒网，我认得那影子。
lines.en: If you cast a net, I know that shadow.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只怕人手里的线。
lines.en: I do not fear people, only the line in their hands.

lines.zh: 你把脚伸进水里，我绕了一圈。
lines.en: You put your feet in the water; I circle once.

lines.zh: 我的虹纹正对着你，算打个招呼。
lines.en: My rainbow stripe faces you; consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 你身上的冷气，让我以为来了同类。
lines.en: The cold on you makes me think kin has come.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻起，冷水灌进伤口。
lines.en: Scales peel back and cold water floods the wound.

lines.zh: 我一下窜出去，撞进石缝。
lines.en: I bolt and jam myself into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 这点伤不算什么，河里天天有。
lines.en: This is nothing; the river deals worse daily.

lines.zh: 我的彩虹被打散了，颜色混作一团。
lines.en: My rainbow scatters, colors running together.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一拍，冷水泼了你一身。
lines.en: My tailfin snaps, and cold water soaks you.

lines.zh: 痛让我游得更低，贴着泥。
lines.en: Pain drives me lower, flat against the silt.

lines.zh: 身后拖着一条淡红的痕。
lines.en: A faint red trail drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我还活着，只是游得歪了。
lines.en: I am alive, just swimming crooked.

lines.zh: 伤口在冷水里不怎么疼。
lines.en: In cold water the wound hardly stings.

lines.zh: 你的气味，我记在鳃里了。
lines.en: Your scent is lodged in my gills now.

lines.zh: 你手里的虫子在动，我的尾鳍也动。
lines.en: The bug in your hand wriggles, and so does my tail.

lines.zh: 我闻到饵味，彩虹全亮了。
lines.en: I smell bait, and my whole rainbow lights up.

lines.zh: 别抖线，我会追着它走。
lines.en: Do not jig the line; I will follow it.

lines.zh: 那团红丝线，像极了我自己。
lines.en: That red thread looks far too much like me.

lines.zh: 我只想咬一口，就一口。
lines.en: I only want one bite. Just one.

lines.zh: 饵沉下去，我的判断也沉了。
lines.en: The bait sinks, and my judgment sinks with it.

lines.zh: 我绕着钩子转第三圈了。
lines.en: This is my third circle around that hook.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑，比水草香。
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter smell better than any weed.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又合上，再张开。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and open it again.

lines.zh: 若我咬钩，算我自己的错。
lines.en: If I take the hook, that is my own fault.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的侧线，我歪了一下。
lines.en: You bump my lateral line and I tilt away.

lines.zh: 急流里撞鱼很正常，别道歉。
lines.en: Bumping fish in fast water is normal; no apology needed.

lines.zh: 我又滑回来，贴着你的靴子。
lines.en: I slide back and press against your boot.

lines.zh: 鳞片被碰掉一片，冷水刺进来。
lines.en: A scale knocked loose lets the cold stab in.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就敢前进一寸。
lines.en: You step back a half pace, and I gain an inch.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，又各自散开。
lines.en: We knock together and scatter apart again.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，我让出半个身位。
lines.en: A companion crowds in and I yield half a body.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，我靠侧线认路。
lines.en: The water muddies; I find my way by my lateral line.

lines.zh: 你脚下打滑，我从你腿边穿过。
lines.en: Your footing slips and I dart between your legs.

lines.zh: 撞一下不算冒犯，在河里很常见。
lines.en: One bump is no insult; it happens often in rivers.

lines.zh: 产卵的浅滩在等我，你也来？
lines.en: The spawning shallows wait for me. Coming?

lines.zh: 我的彩虹此刻最鲜，你看见没有。
lines.en: My rainbow is at its brightest now; do you see it?

lines.zh: 同伴用尾鳍拍沙，那是邀请。
lines.en: My companion slaps the sand with a tail. That is an invitation.

lines.zh: 冷水让这一刻格外清醒。
lines.en: Cold water makes this moment strangely clear.

lines.zh: 我们在卵石上并排摆尾。
lines.en: We beat our tails side by side over the gravel.

lines.zh: 卵会落进石缝，谁也带不走。
lines.en: The eggs will fall into the stones, and no one carries them off.

lines.zh: 明年这群鱼里会有我的条纹。
lines.en: Next year's school will carry my stripe.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这段水流很急。
lines.en: Do not come closer; this current runs fast.

lines.zh: 我的侧线认得出同族的节奏。
lines.en: My lateral line knows the rhythm of my own kind.

lines.zh: 产完这一季，我就瘦了。
lines.en: After this season I will be thin.

lines.zh: 被你捧起来，我的鳃还在动。
lines.en: Lifted in your hands, my gills are still working.

lines.zh: 出水的一刻，彩虹全暗了。
lines.en: The instant I leave the water, my rainbow goes dark.

lines.zh: 别攥太紧，我的骨很细。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; my bones are thin.

lines.zh: 我拍你的掌心，拍不疼你。
lines.en: I slap your palm, and it does not hurt you.

lines.zh: 我要的不是手，是水。
lines.en: I do not want a hand. I want water.

lines.zh: 你的手比海水暖，这不对。
lines.en: Your hands are warmer than the sea. That is wrong.

lines.zh: 把我放进桶里，别扔在沙上。
lines.en: Put me in a bucket, not down on the sand.

lines.zh: 我身上有黏液，会滑走的。
lines.en: I am slick with slime; I will slide free.

lines.zh: 骨粉是我死后才有的东西。
lines.en: Bone meal is what I become only after death.

lines.zh: 这一捧，比整条河都窄。
lines.en: This handful is narrower than the whole river.

lines.zh: 水面有虫落下，我盯住了。
lines.en: A bug hits the surface, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那点银光在动，我锁定了它。
lines.en: That fleck of silver moves; I have it.

lines.zh: 我看见了，那东西比我的嘴小。
lines.en: I see it, and it is smaller than my mouth.

lines.zh: 不是敌人，只是我的下一口。
lines.en: Not an enemy. Just my next mouthful.

lines.zh: 我先缩身，再决定要不要动。
lines.en: I coil my body, then decide whether to move.

lines.zh: 波纹告诉我它的方向和大小。
lines.en: The ripples tell me its direction and size.

lines.zh: 同伴也看见了，我们先来后到。
lines.en: My companion sees it too; first come, first fed.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛偏向那团影子。
lines.en: I angle my eye toward that shadow.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的鳃就快了半拍。
lines.en: It moves, and my gills quicken half a beat.

lines.zh: 这条河里，我总得吃点东西。
lines.en: In this river, I must eat something.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底靠近，不搅起泥。
lines.en: I creep along the bottom without stirring mud.

lines.zh: 推水的声音已经很小了。
lines.en: The sound of my push is already very small.

lines.zh: 再近一寸，就是它的死期。
lines.en: One inch closer and its time is up.

lines.zh: 我绕到逆光那侧，它看不见我。
lines.en: I circle to the backlit side where it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 尾巴不动，只靠胸鳍微调。
lines.en: My tail holds still; only my pectorals trim the aim.

lines.zh: 它还没发现这道彩虹在逼近。
lines.en: It has not noticed this rainbow closing in.

lines.zh: 摆尾三次，我便扑向那点银光。
lines.en: Three tailbeats, then I dart at that fleck of silver.

lines.zh: 水草给了我一条好路线。
lines.en: The weeds have given me a clean line in.

lines.zh: 别催，冷水里不能急。
lines.en: Do not rush me; nothing hurries in cold water.

lines.zh: 彩条朝下，是因为我要扑了。
lines.en: My stripe points down because I am about to strike.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，咬一口就走。
lines.en: My mouth is small; I bite once and go.

lines.zh: 撞它一下，比咬更省力。
lines.en: A ram costs me less than a bite.

lines.zh: 牙齿细，但够撕开壳。
lines.en: My teeth are fine, but they split shells.

lines.zh: 咬住后我猛甩头，扯下一块。
lines.en: Once latched, I whip my head and tear a piece free.

lines.zh: 它挣得太猛，我松了口。
lines.en: It thrashes too hard, so I let go.

lines.zh: 冷水让我的动作不快，却准。
lines.en: Cold water slows me, but I stay accurate.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下，我用牙还你。
lines.en: For that last blow, I answer with my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撞在它侧面，把它顶偏。
lines.en: I hit its flank and knock it off course.

lines.zh: 鱼也可以有脾气。
lines.en: Even a fish can have a temper.

lines.zh: 咬完我退回石缝里。
lines.en: The bite done, I withdraw into the rock seam.

lines.zh: 我在冷水里睁眼，先找河。
lines.en: I open my eyes in cold water and look for the river.

lines.zh: 这里的水温刚好，我留下了。
lines.en: The temperature here is right; I will stay.

lines.zh: 沙底、浅滩，还有同游的伙伴。
lines.en: Sand bottom, shallows, and companions swimming near.

lines.zh: 我身上的虹纹是刚长出来的。
lines.en: The rainbow on me has only just grown in.

lines.zh: 从卵石缝里出来，我先躲一下。
lines.en: Out of the gravel seam, I hide for a moment first.

lines.zh: 四条同伴，一齐摆尾向前。
lines.en: Four companions, all beating tails forward at once.

lines.zh: 这条溪够冷，正合我意。
lines.en: This creek is cold enough for my liking.

lines.zh: 水流声盖住了我出世的动静。
lines.en: The current covers the sound of my arrival.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，认认这条水道。
lines.en: I circle once to learn this channel.

lines.zh: 别踩水里，我刚到这里。
lines.en: Do not step in the water; I have only just arrived.

lines.zh: 热水比火焰更可怕。
lines.en: Hot water frightens me more than flame itself.

lines.zh: 从水面摔下来，我懵了。
lines.en: Dropped from the surface, I land stunned.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，我反倒憋住了气。
lines.en: In the water itself, my breath fails me.

lines.zh: 爆风把我连水一起掀高。
lines.en: The blast lifts me up along with the river.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，钉住了我。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and pins me.

lines.zh: 药水让我的鳃一阵刺痛。
lines.en: The potion makes my gills sting sharply.

lines.zh: 饿得我连水草都想咬。
lines.en: Hungry enough to bite even the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水面过来，我尾都僵了。
lines.en: Thunder runs along the surface and my tail goes stiff.

lines.zh: 没有水的地方，我无法呼吸。
lines.en: Where there is no water, I cannot breathe.
